answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in spiral, verified in sable, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the dawn check. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 43 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
